name: rag_ask
description: Retrieve answer-grounding chunks for a natural-language question from the active workspace index. Runs the full RAG pipeline — query decomposition, HyDE-expanded hybrid search (vector + BM25 + graph) with multi-hop follow-ups, cross-encoder rerank, and a semantic result cache — and returns ranked candidate chunks, each tagged with an [N] citation label plus a ready-to-inject citation block, for the model to ground and cite its answer in. Returns status=insufficient_context when retrieval finds nothing or the confidence gate fires.
